title: The Hollywood Reporter, Animation Is Film Festival Partner on Live Animation Roundtable With Bill Hader, Travis Knight, More
summary: Other participants at the Sunday event in Los Angeles include 'Tangles' director Leah Nelson, 'Hexed' co-director Fawn Veerasunthorn, 'In Waves' director Phuong Mai Nguyen, 'Iron Boy' director Louis Clichy and 'Forgotten Island' co-director Joel Crawford.
